name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light environments and keeps focus on the data, matching Manus’s competitive analysis. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for readability in bright spaces, but the toggle covers that.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode’s glare in bright spaces is real, but the real risk is users missing critical data when they toggle. Settle it with A/B tests: measure error rates and task speed in both modes before defaulting.
